rules: Sort distinct status records by published timestamp and assign sequential indexes.
Classify a record as reposted only when the visible text begins with the Call NYC reposted label; all other recovered account records are authored.
Derive engagement counts from visible X labels, mentions from visible @-links, outgoing links from visible t.co anchors, and media presence from rendered status photo or video anchors.
Classify service-recognition posts as authored records that mention @NYCCouncil and contain provides the most, provided the most, or gives the most.
Normalize CallNYC destinations to HTTPS, lowercase hostname, no query or fragment, and no trailing slash; classify issue pages after excluding the site root and /api.
